title: Google Sheets #N/A? Claude Can Help Find the Problem #shorts
description:
Claude for Google Workspace is now in public beta for paid Claude Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans. Anthropic says the Google Sheets add-on can help explain and fix formulas. This video shows a FICTIONAL lookup example, not a live Claude product demo. Always verify the corrected numbers.

What would you use first: SHEETS or DOCS? Comment your answer.
